description: This file defines the RootPathContextService class, which manages context-aware code snippets for autocompletion based on AST nodes and caching, utilizing tree-sitter queries and IDE integrations.

classes.name: RootPathContextService
classes.description: Service class that provides context-aware code snippets for autocompletion based on AST nodes, caching, and IDE integration.

methods.name: getSnippetsForNode
methods.description: Retrieves code snippets related to a specific AST node, performing tree-sitter queries.

methods.name: getSnippets
methods.description: Fetches code snippets from IDE definitions at a given position.

methods.name: getContextForPath
methods.description: Generates autocomplete snippets based on the AST path, utilizing caching and node filtering.
